item.title: Forum Criticism Team - Captain Post
item.content:encoded:
Since this thread was on page 6 of the forum listing with no responses, this is a quick staff reminder to the author that if you haven't yet, you should contact reviewers directly to request feedback as needed.

Please refer to this thread for more information: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282692/how-to-get-more-reviews

If you have already reached out to multiple reviewers and received no reply, notify a staff member for assistance finding a reviewer.

item.title: Anomalous Chime Seeking Greenlight.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP

Genre (Optional): Light-Hearted/Semi-Comedic

Page Layout (Optional): Standard (Modern Header)

Elevator Pitch: An anomalous chime peaks both the local population, and the Foundation's interests, forcing the Foundation to dig into just where this magical melody is coming from.

Central Narrative: A Specialty shop in Southern FL is producing clocks who's chimes enamor their listeners. Towards the end of opening day as the crowd continues to grow and displace traffic, the authorities are alerted, including our very own Foundation. While having to manage crowd control, they find that upstairs of the clock-store is an peculiar workshop where brass fittings, elaborate blueprints, and the Florida Child Services system are coming together to create a lovely anomalous item. Post-haste our illustrious Foundation secures the area and is now able to devote its energy to a favored past-time: testing logs. Including but not limited to logs from the personnel/civilians on the ground, and logs from the Foundation's bunker where testing can be conducted on D-Class in peace. We also have a neat little epilogue with the arrest of the two individuals responsible, and the return of the children to the foster care system.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The chime itself is a melody (3-12 seconds long) that can be heard as any instrument, vocalization, or combination there-of that the listener would agree was the best song/tune they've heard1. This includes, but is not limited to: A lullaby sung by the listeners deceased mother, a D-Class re-hearing the sound of their abusive father's heart monitor flat-line, and the listener themselves singing the ending of a song they had been struggling to write.

Additional Notes: While the SCP is safe (in its contained form, the crank/winding piece is removed), any listener will, over an extended period of time, become obsessive with the clock, and may begin to prioritize listening to the chime over basic bodily needs.

Testing logs are a list of personnel and the melodies they heard, with accompanying notes section (ranging from somber to sarcastic).
Draft upon request.

Footnotes
1. Subjects rarely can guess what the melody will be prior to hearing it, but all recognize it afterward.
